title: 3D Solids: Faces, Edges and Vertices
seo_title: Grade 2 3D Solids Worksheets: Faces, Edges and Vertices (TEKS 2.8B)
standard_text: 2.8B classify and sort three-dimensional solids, including spheres, cones, cylinders, rectangular prisms (including cubes as special rectangular prisms), and triangular prisms, based on attributes using formal geometric language; 2.8D compose two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional solids with given properties or attributes
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 3D solid worksheets for Texas TEKS 2.8B and 2.8D: spheres, cones, cylinders, cubes and prisms, faces, edges and vertices, and sorting solids. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Faces are flat, edges are lines, vertices are corners.
key_sub: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • 3D solids: sphere, cone, cylinder, cube, rectangular prism, triangular prism.
  • Faces are flat surfaces, edges are where faces meet, vertices are corners.
  • A cube is a special rectangular prism: all 6 faces are squares.
  • Spheres, cones and cylinders have curved surfaces, so they can roll.

Examples

Example

A cereal box

6 rectangle faces

Answer: rectangular prism

Example

Faces of a cube

6 squares

Answer: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up 2D and 3D namesA circle is flat; a sphere is solid.
Counting only the faces you can seeCount the back, bottom and hidden faces too.
Thinking a cube is not a rectangular prismA cube is a special rectangular prism.

faq.a: Classify and sort three-dimensional solids, including spheres, cones, cylinders, rectangular prisms (including cubes as special rectangular prisms) and triangular prisms, based on attributes using formal geometric language.
Compose two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional solids with given properties or attributes.
No. It has 2 flat circle faces and no corners.
A flat shape that folds up into a solid.

sets.title: Name the solid from a clue

items.q: It has 1 flat circle face and 1 vertex. Which solid is it?
items.e: A cone: it has 1 flat circle face and 1 vertex.

items.q: It is round like a ball and can roll. Which solid is it?
items.e: A sphere: it is round like a ball and can roll.

items.q: It has 2 flat circle faces and can roll. Which solid is it?
items.e: A cylinder: it has 2 flat circle faces and can roll.

items.q: It has 6 rectangle faces, like a box. Which solid is it?
items.e: A rectangular prism: it has 6 rectangle faces, like a box.

items.q: It has 2 triangle faces and 3 rectangle faces. Which solid is it?
items.e: A triangular prism: it has 2 triangle faces and 3 rectangle faces.

items.q: It has 6 square faces. Which solid is it?
items.e: A cube: it has 6 square faces.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a traffic cone?
items.e: A traffic cone is shaped like a cone.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a globe?
items.e: A globe is shaped like a sphere.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a wedge of cheese?
items.e: A wedge of cheese is shaped like a triangular prism.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a party hat?
items.e: A party hat is shaped like a cone.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a drum?
items.e: A drum is shaped like a cylinder.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a marble?
items.e: A marble is shaped like a sphere.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a can of beans?
items.e: A can of beans is shaped like a cylinder.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a brick?
items.e: A brick is shaped like a rectangular prism.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a candle?
items.e: A candle is shaped like a cylinder.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a tent?
items.e: A tent is shaped like a triangular prism.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a juice box?
items.e: A juice box is shaped like a rectangular prism.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a cereal box?
items.e: A cereal box is shaped like a rectangular prism.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a number cube?
items.e: A number cube is shaped like a cube.

items.q: Which solid is shaped like a basketball?
items.e: A basketball is shaped like a sphere.

items.q: How many faces does a cube have?
items.e: A face is a flat side. You can see 3 faces, but there are 3 more on the back, the bottom and the left: 3 + 3 = 6.

items.q: How many edges does a cube have?
items.e: An edge is where 2 faces meet. There are 4 edges on the front, 4 on the back and 4 going from front to back: 12. The dashed lines are edges you cannot see, so count them too.

items.q: How many vertices (corners) does a cube have?
items.e: A vertex is a corner where edges meet. There are 4 on the front and 4 on the back: 8. One vertex is hidden at the back, where the dashed lines meet.

items.q: What is the red part called?
items.e: The red part is a flat surface of the cube. A flat surface of a solid is called a face.

items.q: What is the red line called?
items.e: The red line is where 2 faces meet. That is an edge.

items.q: What is the red dot on?
items.e: The dot is on a corner where 3 edges meet. A corner of a solid is a vertex. (Two or more are vertices.)

items.q: What shape is each face of a cube?
items.e: Every face of a cube is a square, and all 6 squares are the same size.

items.q: How many faces of this cube can you see?
items.e: You can see the front, the top and the right side: 3 faces. The other 3 faces are hidden.

items.q: How many faces does this box have?
items.e: This solid is a rectangular prism. It has a front and back, a top and bottom, and a left and right side: 6 faces.

items.q: How many edges does this box have?
items.e: 4 edges on the front, 4 on the back and 4 joining them: 12. Count the 3 dashed edges too.

items.q: How many vertices does this box have?
items.e: 4 vertices on the front and 4 on the back: 8. One of them is hidden.

items.q: How is a cube different from this box?
items.e: Both have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. A cube's 6 faces are all the same square. This box has long and short faces.

items.q: Which solid is a cube?
items.e: Picture D has 6 faces that are all the same square. One shape is a flat square, not a solid. The long box has faces that are not all squares, and the pyramid has triangle faces.

items.q: Which solid is NOT a cube?
items.e: Solid A is a tall box. Its front is not a square, so its faces are not all the same. The other three are cubes: one is small and one is drawn from the left, but size and turning do not matter.

items.q: How many edges meet at each vertex of a cube?
items.e: At every corner of a cube, 3 edges meet: one going up or down, one going side to side and one going back.

items.q: Which word means a flat surface of a solid?
items.e: A face is a flat surface. An edge is where 2 faces meet. A vertex is a corner.

items.q: A cube has 6 faces. You can see 3 faces. How many faces are hidden?
items.e: 6 − 3 = 3. The hidden faces are the back, the bottom and one side.

items.q: A cube has 12 edges. In a picture, 9 edges are solid lines. The rest are dashed. How many are dashed?
items.e: 12 − 9 = 3. Dashed lines show the edges you cannot see.

items.q: Is a square the same as a cube?
items.e: A square is a flat shape with 4 sides. A cube is a solid with 6 square faces.

items.q: A cube has 8 vertices. You can see 7 in this picture. How many are hidden?
items.e: 8 − 7 = 1. The hidden vertex is at the back, where the 3 dashed edges meet.

sets.title: Faces, edges and vertices of solids

items.q: A flat surface of a 3D object is called a …
items.e: A face is a flat surface. An edge is where two faces meet. A vertex is a corner.

items.q: The line where two faces of an object meet is called an …
items.e: Where two faces meet there is an edge.

items.q: A corner of an object, where edges meet, is called a …
items.e: A corner is a vertex. More than one vertex are called vertices.

items.q: This is a cube. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Some faces are at the back or underneath. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.

items.q: This is a cube. How many edges does it have?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. The dashed lines show edges at the back. Count them too.

items.q: This is a cube. How many vertices does it have?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Some vertices are at the back, where the dashed lines meet. Count them too.

items.q: This is a rectangular prism. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Some faces are at the back or underneath. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.

items.q: This is a rectangular prism. How many edges does it have?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. The dashed lines show edges at the back. Count them too.

items.q: This is a triangular prism. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. Some faces are at the back or underneath. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.

items.q: This is a triangular prism. How many edges does it have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. The dashed lines show edges at the back. Count them too.

items.q: This is a triangular prism. How many vertices does it have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices. Some vertices are at the back, where the dashed lines meet. Count them too.

items.q: This is a square-based pyramid. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A square-based pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Some faces are at the back or underneath. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.

items.q: This is a square-based pyramid. How many edges does it have?
items.e: A square-based pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. The dashed lines show edges at the back. Count them too.

items.q: This is a square-based pyramid. How many vertices does it have?
items.e: A square-based pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Some vertices are at the back, where the dashed lines meet. Count them too. Do not forget the vertex at the top.

items.q: This is a triangle-based pyramid. How many faces does it have?
items.e: A triangle-based pyramid has 4 faces, 6 edges and 4 vertices. Some faces are at the back or underneath. You cannot see them, but you must count them too.
A cylinder has no corners, so it has 0 vertices. Its 2 edges are curved circles, not corners. In a drawing it can look like it has 4 corners, but it does not.
A cone has 1 vertex: the point at the top. Its circle edge is curved and has no corners.

items.q: Every face of a cube is a square. How many right angles does one face have?
items.e: A square has 4 square corners, so it has 4 right angles. 8 is the number of vertices of the whole cube.

items.q: Which object has right angles at every corner of every face?
items.e: All 6 faces of a rectangular prism are rectangles, and every rectangle has 4 right angles. Pyramids and triangular prisms have triangle faces, and a triangle can never have a right angle at every corner.

items.q: Ethan says a cube has 8 edges. He is wrong. What did he count?
items.e: A cube has 8 vertices (corners) and 12 edges. Ethan counted the vertices.

items.q: Which 2D shapes are the faces of a triangular prism?
items.e: A triangular prism has a triangle at each end (2 triangles) and 3 rectangles joining them: 5 faces.

items.q: Which 2D shapes are the faces of a square-based pyramid?
items.e: A square-based pyramid has 1 square at the bottom and 4 triangles that meet at the top: 5 faces.

items.q: Which 2D shapes are the faces of a triangle-based pyramid?
items.e: It has 3 triangles that meet at the top and 1 more triangle as the base: 3 + 1 = 4 triangles. Do not forget the base.

items.q: Which 2D shapes are the faces of a rectangular prism like a cereal box?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces and each one is a rectangle: front and back, top and bottom, and 2 ends.
The flat faces of a cylinder are circles. In a drawing they look like ovals because we see them from the side.

items.q: What shape is the flat face of a cone?
items.e: A cone has 1 flat face: a circle. From the side a cone looks like a triangle, but it has no triangle faces.

items.q: Ximena dips one face of a cube in paint and presses it on paper. What shape does she print?
items.e: Every face of a cube is a square, so the print is a square. A print is flat (2D), so it cannot be a cube.

items.q: Nevaeh traces around the bottom of a soup can. What shape does she draw?
items.e: The can is a cylinder and its bottom face is a circle, so the tracing is a circle.

items.q: You press each face of an object in paint. Which object can print a triangle?
items.e: A triangular prism has a triangle face at each end. A cube, a cylinder and a rectangular prism have no triangle faces.

items.q: Which object can print 1 square and 4 triangles?
items.e: A square-based pyramid has 1 square face and 4 triangle faces.

items.q: How many square faces does a square-based pyramid have?
items.e: Only the base is a square: 1 square face. The other 4 faces are triangles.

items.q: How many triangle faces does a triangular prism have?
items.e: A triangular prism has 1 triangle at each end: 2 triangles. Its name says “triangle”, but its other 3 faces are rectangles.

items.q: How many rectangle faces does a triangular prism have?
items.e: The 3 faces that join the 2 triangle ends are rectangles: 3 rectangles.

items.q: A net is a flat shape you can fold to make a 3D object. How many squares are in a net of a cube?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, so its net has 6 squares, one for each face. 8 is the number of vertices.

items.q: This net is folded up. Which 3D object does it make?
items.e: 6 squares of the same size fold up into a cube: 1 square for each face.

items.q: This net is folded up. Which 3D object does it make?
items.e: The square is the base. The 4 triangles fold up and meet at a point: a square-based pyramid.

items.q: This net is folded up. Which 3D object does it make?
items.e: The 3 rectangles fold into a tube and the 2 triangles close the ends: a triangular prism.

items.q: This net is folded up. Which 3D object does it make?
items.e: 6 rectangles that are not all squares fold into a rectangular prism, like a box.

items.q: This net is folded up. Which 3D object does it make?
items.e: The rectangle rolls into a tube (the curved surface) and the 2 circles close the ends: a cylinder.

items.q: Harper dips one face of a cube in paint and presses it on paper. What shape does she print?
items.e: Every face of a cube is a square, so the print is a square. A print is flat (2D), so it cannot be a cube.

items.q: Which solids have a curved surface?
items.e: Spheres, cones and cylinders have curved surfaces.

items.q: Which solid can roll and can also stack?
items.e: A cylinder has flat faces to stack and a curved surface to roll.

items.q: Which solid is a special rectangular prism with all square faces?
items.e: A cube is a rectangular prism with 6 equal square faces.

items.q: Two cubes are put side by side. What solid do they make?
items.e: Two cubes together make a longer box: a rectangular prism.

items.q: How many vertices does a cone have?
items.e: A cone has 1 vertex at its point.

items.q: Which solid has exactly 5 faces?
items.e: 2 triangles + 3 rectangles = 5 faces.

items.q: Which solid has no flat faces?
items.e: A sphere is curved all over.

items.q: Think of a rectangular prism. Count the hidden ones too. How many edges does it have in all?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 12 edges.

items.q: Think of a rectangular prism. Count the hidden ones too. How many faces does it have in all?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 6 faces.

items.q: Think of a cube. Count the hidden ones too. How many edges does it have in all?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 12 edges.

items.q: Think of a triangular prism. Count the hidden ones too. How many vertices does it have in all?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices, so it has 6 vertices.

items.q: Think of a cube. Count the hidden ones too. How many faces does it have in all?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 6 faces.

items.q: Think of a triangular prism. Count the hidden ones too. How many faces does it have in all?
items.e: A triangular prism has 5 faces, 9 edges and 6 vertices, so it has 5 faces.

items.q: Think of a cube. Count the hidden ones too. How many vertices does it have in all?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 8 vertices.

items.q: Think of a rectangular prism. Count the hidden ones too. How many vertices does it have in all?
items.e: A rectangular prism has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices, so it has 8 vertices.

items.q: Which has more vertices: a cone or a cylinder?
items.e: A cone has 1 vertex; a cylinder has 0.

items.q: Do a cube and a rectangular prism have the same number of faces?
items.e: Both have 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices.

items.q: Which has more flat faces: a cylinder or a cone?
items.e: A cylinder has 2 flat faces; a cone has 1.

items.q: Which has fewer vertices: a triangular prism or a rectangular prism?
items.e: A triangular prism has 6 vertices; a rectangular prism has 8.

items.q: Which has more faces: a cube or a triangular prism?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces; a triangular prism has 5. A cube has more.
